name: Posti Group Oyj
summary: Posti Group Oyj operates as a distribution and logistics company in Finland, Sweden, Norway, Baltics, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Postal Services; eCommerce and Delivery Services; and Fulfillment and Logistics Services. The Postal Services segment provides delivery services, multichannel services and digital services, as well as corporate and consumer letters, multichannel messaging solutions, newspaper and magazine delivery, and addressed direct marketing services. The eCommerce and Delivery Services segment provides parcel delivery; and freight and other services.
